user.title: Connect Fuse Energy
user.description: Sign in at https://www.fuseenergy.com, open DevTools → Application → Cookies → https://www.fuseenergy.com, and paste the values of the **session_id** and **app-auth** cookies below. Find your premises ID in the URL after opening a property (https://www.fuseenergy.com/app/premises/<this-uuid>).

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Fuse Energy. Check your network and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Fuse Energy rejected those cookies. Sign in again and re-copy them.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Fuse Energy account can be configured.
